ingredients.name: avocado oil
ingredients.note: half of the cup of avocado oil

steps.instruction: Cut your meat on sizes like this.
Thinly slice onions and chop carrots on a matchsticks.
Preheat your pan on very high, add half of the cup of avocado oil.
Fry just half of the meat till it's golden.
In the same oil cook our onions.
Add our carrots and cook for 70 minutes till the carrots will get softened.
Return our meat, add black pepper and special spice for plov.
Mix it together, add hot water, good amount of salt and simmer it for 40 minutes.
Add whole head of garlic in the middle.
Add 2 cups of basmati rice and hot water that it will cover our rice on a half inch.
Cook it uncovered on medium heat till most of the water will disappear.
Cover it with the lid, lower the temperature and simmer it for 25 more minutes.
Make a special salad with thinly sliced tomatoes, super thinly sliced onion, salt and walnut oil.
